SourceCodeRepoProvider.name: SourceCodeRepoProvider
SourceCodeRepoProvider.description: Represents a supported source (version) control system like GitHub or Bitbucket.

BaseUrl.description: The base URL of the source control repository provider. For example, https://github.com.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: The unique name for the source control repository provider.

NamedCredential.description: The name of the named credential that DevOps Center uses to connect to this source control provider.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the user or group that owns this record.
